notes: Pick your own notification sound. Notification settings has six to choose from — Glass, Pulse, Lumen, Bloom, Drip and Orbit — and tapping one plays it straight away so you choose by ear, not by name. Your choice is remembered on this phone, is the sound you hear for a Whisper, and is the sound the notification bar uses when holUpp is closed. This build also fixes the in-app banner so it appears as soon as something arrives while you are using holUpp.
